source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of classes and objects (PDF 57).

blocks.text: Class cheezein banane ka saancha (template) hai, aur object us saanche se bani asal cheez. Farz karein aap khilona gaari banana chahte hain. Pehle aap ko naqsha (blueprint) chahiye jo bataye ke gaari kaisi dikhe aur kaise kaam kare. Is naqshe mein yeh tafseel hoti hai:
Naqsha khud gaari nahi; yeh sirf mansooba hai, aur yahi class hai.

Isi naqshe se aap kai gaariyan bana sakte hain. Har gaari ki apni khasoosiyat hogi, jaise alag rang ya size. Yahi asal objects hain jin se aap khel sakte hain. Har object class ka instance (namoona) hai: woh naqshe par chalta hai magar us ki apni values hoti hain.

blocks.prompt: Class aur object mein farq samjhaiye (short question 8).
blocks.explanation: Class aisa mansooba hai jo batata hai ke us ke objects ke kaunse attributes aur methods honge; object us mansoobe se bana ek asal instance hai jis ki apni qeematein hain: ToyCar class hai, car1 (laal, chhoti, 4 pahiye) object hai.

items: Class: naqsha; object: us se bani asal cheez (instance).
